bagPolicy.summary: Visitors are encouraged to arrive without large bags. Only small backpacks, handbags, or fabric tote bags with few compartments are allowed.
allowed: fabric tote bag with few compartments
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking availability, access routes, and pricing at Veikkaus Arena can vary by event. Review the linked official information and reserve in advance when that option is offered.

rideshare.note: Use the taxi deck at Veturitie 13, 00240 Helsinki, for taxi pickup and drop-off.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at Veikkaus Arena varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: All floors are reachable by elevator, and accessible restrooms are near the wheelchair platforms. Accessible parking is on parking deck 4, with elevator access to the main entrance. Arrangements can vary by event, so email info@veikkausarena.fi with questions.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Veikkaus Arena's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Tickets are delivered to your Ticketmaster account within 15 minutes of purchase. On event days, the Veikkaus Arena ticket office is open at the upper entrance and typically opens about an hour before doors.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Veikkaus Arena. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
